record.dic_text:
05734 `Adnah {ad-naw'}

源自 05727; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Adnah 2; 2

押拿 = "愉悅"
1) 一位瑪拿西人, 他背棄掃羅而在洗革拉投入大衛的麾下 (#代上 12:20|)
2) 約沙法時一位統領卅萬猶大勇士的軍事將領 (#代下 17:14|)
record.edic_text:
05734 `Adnah {ad-naw'}

from 05727;; n pr m

AV - Adnah 2; 2

Adnah = "pleasure"
1) a Manassite who deserted from Saul and joined David at Ziklag
2) a captain in charge of over 300,000 men of Judah in the time of
   Jehoshaphat
